Policy

Editorial policy and methodology

The standards we hold our reports, this site and our apps to.

Numbers come from data, with a time attached

Every price, percentage and count we publish is taken from market data or computed from it by code. We do not estimate a number we do not have. Each report states the trading session it describes and the time it was generated, and each archive page says whether that time was before or after the market's close. When a report could not get data for some of its tickers, its coverage line says how many are missing.

One identifiable source for every page

A report revision is published as a single data file identified by a hash. Our apps and this site read a pointer to the latest file and refuse the data if its hash does not match. Each archive page prints the first twelve characters of that hash, so a reader, or we, can tell exactly which data a page was built from.

Description, not prediction

Our text describes what the data shows and how our rules classify it. We do not publish price targets of our own, we do not tell readers to buy or sell, and we avoid language that implies a forecast. Screens and scores rank tickers or contracts against fixed criteria on a given day. They are not recommendations.

Methodology

The rules behind every label and score, with their thresholds, are published in how DappGo computes its signals. When a rule changes we update that page and its date.

Third-party news

News in our products is shown as the publisher's headline, the publisher's name and a link to the original article. We do not republish article text. Translated headlines are machine translations that are checked against the original for numbers and dates; a translation that fails the check is not shown.

Corrections

If you find a wrong number, tell us through the contact page with the page address and the figure. When an error is in the data or in our code, we fix the cause and rebuild the affected pages from corrected data, and the generation time on the page changes. When an error is in a guide or a policy page, we correct the text and update the date at the foot of that page. We do not silently delete a session from the archive to hide a mistake.

Advertising and independence

Some pages on this site may show advertising served by Google AdSense, and some of our apps show ads. Advertisers do not see our reports before publication and have no say in what we measure, which tickers we track or how anything is ranked. No company can pay to be included in a report, a screen or a ranking. We keep advertising off our legal, support and contact pages.

People who work on DappGo may own securities that appear in the reports. The reports are generated by fixed rules that apply equally to every ticker on the list.

Use of AI

Where language models are used in our products, and the limits placed on them, is described in how we use AI.

Not investment advice

DappGo is not a licensed investment adviser. Our material is general research and education. It does not consider your objectives, finances or tolerance for loss. Markets can fall and option selling in particular can lose much more than the premium received. See the terms of service.
